data.text:
LOOK: Artists and peasant advocates prepare a banner mural ahead of the October 21 “Baha sa Liwasang Bonifacio”farmer-led anti-corruption protests.

Artists put the finishing touches on the banner mural titled “Mamamayan at Magbubukid: Wakasan ang Korapsyon at Pang-aapi.” The protest artwork, painted collaboratively by young artists, cultural workers, and peasant advocates, will be featured during the October 21 Baha sa Liwasang Bonifacio anti-corruption protest led by Kilusang Bayan Kontra Kurakot, Taumbayan Ayaw sa Magnanakaw, BAYAN, and KMP.

Farmers and indigenous peoples are now on their fourth day of a protest camp outside the Department of Agrarian Reform for the Kampuhan ng mga Magsasaka para sa Lupa at Laban sa Korapsyon.

📷 Images from KMP/SAKA
